name: Rakuten Bank Ltd
summary: Operating in Japan, Rakuten Bank, Ltd. delivers a comprehensive suite of online banking solutions. For individual clients, its offerings encompass diverse financial tools such as payment processing, convenient money transfers, prepaid cards, both local Yen and foreign currency deposit options, remittance services, various loan products, lottery access, account aggregation, foreign exchange trading, and asset management expertise. Businesses benefit from a separate range of services, including corporate debit cards, ATM deposit facilities, business loans, global remittance capabilities, payment and transfer solutions, account verification, withdrawal options, settlement services, and general deposit accounts. Established in Tokyo, Japan, in 2000, Rakuten Bank, Ltd. functions as a subsidiary under the umbrella of Rakuten Group, Inc.
